title: Good News to Share
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who goes to look and see, and tonight four hungry men go to look at the enemy camp and find it full of food: Scout finds ripe strawberries behind the fence and runs back to share them first.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because the four men went to look, and what they found was too good to keep. In Scout’s world today: Scout finds a patch of ripe strawberries behind the fence. One berry, then two, and then Scout stops. Scout’s little sister is still on the swings. Scout runs back across the yard calling, “Come and see!” and fills her hands first. Just like the four men who found food in the empty camp, Scout learned that good news is better when you share it.
